title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2606.17702v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Characterising the TME from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, biological feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SegTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing all three requirements end-to-end: a segmentation backbone that converts raw H\&E patches into per-nucleus class labels, a structured feature-extraction pipeline that turns those labels into quantitative TME descriptors, and a language-model narrative generator that turns those descriptors into clinician-readable text. At its core is UNI2-UperHoVer, a dual-head multiscale segmentation model that pairs UNI2 with two parallel UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and one for HV gradient regression enabling watershed-based nuclear instance separation. translated_title: SegTME-UNI2：一种基于基础模型的通用多类细胞分割与大语言模型驱动的组织病理学肿瘤微环境表征框架
translated_abstract: 从常规H&E染色的组织学图像中表征肿瘤微环境（TME）需要同时进行细胞分割、生物特征提取和可解释的临床报告生成。我们提出了SegTME-UNI2，这是一个端到端地满足上述三项需求的统一框架：一个将原始H&E图像块转换为逐细胞核类别标签的分割骨干网络，一个将这些标签转换为定量TME描述符的结构化特征提取流程，以及一个将这些描述符转换为临床医生可读文本的语言模型叙事生成器。其核心是UNI2-UperHoVer，这是一个双头多尺度分割模型，将UNI2与两个并行的UperNet解码器配对：一个用于六类语义分割，另一个用于HV梯度回归，从而实现基于分水岭算法的细胞核实例分离。该模型通过三阶段渐进式伪标签课程进行训练，从PanNuke（第一阶段，0.25微米/像素）扩展到TCGA-UT Scale-0（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了SegTME-UNI2统一框架，基于基础模型UNI2与双头UperNet解码器实现可泛化的六类细胞核分割，并结合结构化特征提取和大语言模型自动生成肿瘤微环境的临床可读报告。
en_tdlr: SegTME-UNI2 is a unified end-to-end framework that pairs the UNI2 foundation model with dual UperNet decoders for generalisable six-class nucleus segmentation, and integrates structured feature extraction with LLM-driven narrative generation for interpretable tumour microenvironment characterisation in H&E histopathology.
